verdict.rationale: BVNK documents automation rules that link fiat virtual accounts to crypto addresses (POST /payment/v1/rules), so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those rules. API versioning such as the Transfers v3 migration concerns the API itself, not the user's automations, and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
